posts: Cookies are fading; fingerprinting is not. In 2026 the EU data protection supervisor (EDPS) asked if rules can keep up with tracking that needs no cookie. What can a page read about your browser? Nothing is sent until you press a button: https://joseasenjo.github.io/tracker-watch/go/check/ #privacy
alt_text: Screenshot of the Tracker Watch Browser check results: 26 details a script could read, signs of fingerprint defences none seen, ad filter in the browser not detected, privacy signals off, a combined code, and a list starting with the user agent and languages, each marked as often shared but narrowing things down.
